cards.contentText: The unique stripes of zebras make them one of the animals most familiar to people.
cards.contentTextLong: The unique stripes of zebras make them one of the animals most familiar to people. They occur in a variety of habitats, such as grasslands, savannas, woodlands, thorny scrublands, mountains, and coastal hills. Various anthropogenic factors have had a severe impact on zebra populations, in particular hunting for skins and habitat destruction. Grévy's zebra and the mountain zebra are endangered. While plains zebras are much more plentiful, one subspecies, the quagga.

faq.noMatches: No matches found. Try refining your search or browse through the categories to find the help you need.
faq.q1Title: How do I reload a page?
faq.q1Intro: Get ready for some page-refreshing wisdom! We're about to dive into the magical world of reloading web pages. Here are some techniques:
faq.q1Step1: Press the F5 key or Ctrl + R (Windows/Linux) or Command + R (Mac) to manually reload the current page.
faq.q1Step2: Click the reload button in your browser. It usually looks like a circular arrow and is typically located in the address bar.
faq.q1Step3: Use JavaScript to reload the page programmatically: location.reload();
faq.q2P1: A Secure Key is an extra layer of security that helps look after you and your money by generating a unique, single use security code every time you log on or authorise a payment. There are two types of Secure Key - a Digital version that works as part of the Mobile Banking App - perfect if you have a smartphone or tablet. Or, you can use a Physical version that is a little key ring that looks like a mini calculator.
faq.q2P2: We recommend setting up a Digital Secure Key. It’s built into the first direct Banking App, and if you have the right type of smartphone you can use your fingerprint or face recognition to seamlessly log on or authorise payments.
faq.q2Link: Find out more about Secure Keys
faq.q3P1: Reporting fraud is a serious matter, and it's important to take appropriate steps to address and prevent fraudulent activities. The specific process for reporting fraud may vary based on your location and the nature of the fraud, but here's a general guide:
faq.q3Li1Text: Depending on the nature of the fraud, you may need to report to other relevant authorities, such as the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) for investment-related fraud or the Better Business Bureau (BBB) for scams and deceptive practices.
faq.q3Li2Text: Make sure to document all the relevant details about the fraud, including dates, times, names of individuals involved (if known), financial transactions, and any communication related to the fraud.
faq.q3Li3Text: If the fraud involves online activities, consider reporting to organizations that deal with internet crimes, such as the Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). IC3 is a partnership between the FBI and the National White Collar Crime Center.
faq.q3P2: Remember to act promptly and follow the specific reporting procedures relevant to your location and the type of fraud you've encountered. Taking swift action can help mitigate potential damage and prevent further fraudulent activities.
faq.q4P1: Downloading statements can vary depending on the type of statements you're referring to (e.g., bank statements, credit card statements, utility statements). Below are general steps to download statements from various platforms:
faq.q4Li1Text: Always access and download statements from a secure and trusted network to protect your sensitive financial information.
faq.q4Li2Text: Review your statements regularly to verify transactions, detect errors, or identify any suspicious activity promptly.
faq.q4Li3Text: Ensure that the statements you download correspond to the correct account, including account numbers and account names.
faq.q4Li4Text: Download statements only from official and authorized platforms, such as your bank's official website or the secure online portals of service providers.
faq.q4P2: Always ensure that you follow the specific steps and instructions provided by the respective service provider to download statements securely and accurately. If you encounter any difficulties or have specific questions, consider reaching out to the customer support of the respective institution or service.
